runtime_boundary: Game 5.0.1048522, mods/modKarinReplacer/content with blob0.bundle and the generated metadata.store. Project builds made with the original scripts ran in game on the project machine: load and Geralt hidden (T1), model and actions (r2), physics and the intro-cutscene face (agent shots), and v0.4.3 (twin tails / side hair keep their shape at rest, no face clipping when running) accepted by the user. v0.4.4 (hip-level skirt ring kept at its rest clearance) is deployed and offline-checked only. The portable copies were run offline only (2026-10-23): prepare.ps1 + pipeline.ps1 from a fresh work root reproduced 822 of the 829 packed files of v0.4.4 byte for byte; the body w2mesh differs only in vertex order (as between two runs of the same scripts) and is equal as vertex / face / UV multisets with named weights (checks/blender/cmp_w2mesh.py); the six xbm textures embed the absolute PNG source path and differ only by it and the dependent header size / offset / CRC fields. The kit's templates with the project's v0.4.4 depot, packed by the kit's build_mod.py and w3metadata_write.py, give the v0.4.4 blob0.bundle and metadata.store byte for byte. rule_check.py, skirt_walk_sink.py and face_geom.py gave the project's results. -Deploy and the in-game test were not re-run with the kit.
